data.narrative: Customer Viktor Petrov conducted 8 cash deposits totaling $74,200 over three days across five branch locations, with each deposit ranging from $8,500 to $9,900. This pattern is consistent with deliberate structuring to avoid the $10,000 CTR reporting threshold. Follow-up transaction monitoring revealed rapid movement of funds via wire and cryptocurrency channels to high-risk jurisdictions including Estonia, UAE, and Hong Kong. Graph analysis identified layering through intermediary accounts (ACC-10088, ACC-10099) and ultimate distribution to offshore entities in Cyprus and UAE. The customer's email address is flagged in external fraud databases (FinCEN 314(b), ACAMS, FraudNet) for prior involvement in structuring and trade-based money laundering. One wire transfer ($9,950) to Pacific Trade Holdings was successfully recalled with 72% recovery probability. Account ACC-10042 has been frozen pending investigation; linked accounts ACC-10088 and ACC-10099 frozen for 72 hours. This activity represents a high-risk BSA/AML violation requiring regulatory notification.
